explanation: The statement is an introduction rule for the library's own definition `TauCeti.Cube.prodBoundary (N : Type*) : Set (I × I^N) := {y | (y.1 = 0 ∨ y.1 = 1) ∨ y.2 ∈ Cube.boundary N}`, which has no counterpart in Mathlib. Mathlib's `Mathlib/Topology/Homotopy/HomotopyGroup.lean` only defines `Cube.boundary (N : Type*) : Set (I^N)` and lemmas about it (`Cube.boundary_sum_iff`, `Cube.insertAt_boundary`), and greps for `prodBoundary` / `prod_boundary` / `mem_boundary` in Mathlib return nothing of this shape. The closest Mathlib lemma, `Cube.insertAt_boundary`, is about `insertAt` into `Cube.boundary N` rather than about a set of pairs `I × I^N`, so it does not cover this result (and `Cube.insertAt_boundary i (Or.inr h)` lands in `boundary _`, not in any product-boundary set). The theorem's content is entirely the library's own definition, so it is not a duplicate of anything in Mathlib.
